messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-rotation, high error rate spike from edge gateways — TLS handshake failures 5xx observed across multiple regions. Alert threshold breached (5xx > 7% over 5m). Please respond.

Eli M: I'm on it. Seeing a surge of 502/525 from edge-proxy to upstream; initial traces show TLS handshake aborted with "unknown ca" and "bad certificate" in a subset of clients.

Priya S: Which certs were rotated recently? I recall we deployed a CA bundle update last night for the rotator.

Marco L: Correct — rotator pushed new intermediate chain to rotator service at ~2129998800. Edge package should have pulled it, but logs show a 404 for chain artifact during the edge agent update window.

Eli M: Can someone run a quick curl test from edge to a known upstream to reproduce? Use `--tlsv1.2 -v` to capture handshake.

Marco L: Running now from eu-edge-03: ```curl -v --tlsv1.2 https://upstream.internal/api/health 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'```

Marco L: Output snippet: ```* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1): * TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS alert, unknown CA (552): TLS alert number 48 * Closing connection 0```

Priya S: "unknown CA" strongly suggests the intermediate CA isn't trusted by the edge proxy's cert store. Could be a packaging bug in the rotator where the intermediate wasn't appended to the leaf bundle.

SRE-Bot: Detected spike window: 2134999800 - 2135000000. Affected regions: eu-west, us-east (partial), ap-south (small). Impact: 8.6% 5xx on API-GW. Top impacted customer segment: long-tail self-serve keys (anonymous).

Support Team: Customer Ops reporting multiple enterprise customers with increased 502s, some complaining real-user sign-in failures. Need triage on customer-facing impact.

Customer Ops: We're collecting customer session IDs. Initial sample shows failures originate from clients that validate the full cert chain (stricter CA validation). Some mobile clients appear unaffected due to pinned cert bundles.

Eli M: Mitigation plan: 1) Short-term: disable OCSP stapling and reduce TLS strictness on edge for legacy validation to allow fallback. 2) Mid-term: re-publish corrected CA bundle and force rotator re-sync. 3) Rollback option: revert to previous cert bundle if re-publish fails.

Priya S: Disabling OCSP stapling is risky but OK as a temporary measure for 10-15m. How do we toggle per-region?

Marco L: We have a runtime toggle via the config service: `edge.tls.ocsp_stapling.enabled`. I can flip it for eu-west and us-east first. Command: `pctl config set edge.tls.ocsp_stapling.enabled=false --selector region=eu-west,us-east --author=MarcoL`

Eli M: Do it. Also start a canary route: shift 10% of traffic to fallback-cert variant that has the full chain embedded. `routectl promote fallback-cert --weight 10% --region eu-west`

Marco L: Executing... ```$ pctl config set edge.tls.ocsp_stapling.enabled=false --selector region=eu-west,us-east --author=MarcoL OK: 2 regions updated```

Marco L: ```$ routectl promote fallback-cert --weight 10% --region eu-west OK: route updated```

SRE-Bot: After toggles: 5xx rate dropped from 8.6% -> 5.1% in eu-west (1m window). Still above baseline but improving.

Customer Ops: Enterprise customers in eu-west reporting partial recovery. Mobile pinned clients still ok. Desktop clients that strictly validate CA chain still see intermittent failures.

Eli M: Next: Infra Eng please prepare corrected CA bundle artifact. Suspected issue: rotator omitted intermediate cert due to newline parsing bug. Need artifact with concatenated chain (leaf+intermediate+root) in PEM.

Infra Eng: Building corrected bundle now. Will push to artifact-store and trigger rotator job with `rotatorctl resync --artifact ca_bundle_v2.pem`. ETA 7-10 minutes.

Priya S: While that's building, can we widen fallback weight to 30% to buy time? Also add rate-limiting exemptions for enterprise keys to reduce customer impact.

Eli M: Yes widen canary to 30% in eu-west and 15% in us-east. Then add an exception rule: `ratelimit.retries.exempt = true` for enterprise tenant IDs.

Marco L: Commands executed: ```routectl promote fallback-cert --weight 30% --region eu-west OK``` ```routectl promote fallback-cert --weight 15% --region us-east OK``` ```rlctl add-exemption --tenant enterprise_* --duration 30m OK```

SRE-Bot: After widening: eu-west 5xx -> 3.2%, us-east 5xx -> 4.8% (rolling). Overall traffic healthy but still not nominal.

Infra Eng: Artifact uploaded: `ca_bundle_v2.pem` (sha256: ab12c3...). Triggering rotator resync: ```rotatorctl resync --artifact ca_bundle_v2.pem --author=InfraEng```

Infra Eng: Rotator logs: ```INFO  Rotator: fetching artifact ca_bundle_v2.pem INFO  Rotator: validating chain OK INFO  Rotator: pushing to edge-package-service OK```

Marco L: Edge package service reports successful update for 80% of edge fleet; remaining 20% show `artifact fetch 404` from internal CDN. Looks like a transient propagation failure; triggering retry.

Eli M: Retry the CDN edge invalidation/prefetch and force the update for the remaining nodes: `pkgctl flush --package ca_bundle_v2.pem --force` then `pkgctl push --selector region=eu-west,us-east --force`

Marco L: Executed. Later logs: ```pkgctl: push complete. All nodes report new bundle v2. Health checks passing.```

SRE-Bot: Final check: 5xx now at 0.9% in eu-west, 1.3% in us-east, ap-south unchanged at 0.6%. Incident considered mitigated.

Customer Ops: Confirmed with 3 affected enterprise customers; all indicate service normalized. Informing customers and moving to post-incident comms.

Eli M: Moving to postmortem. Owner: Marco L. Action items: - Root cause: rotator packaging bug that dropped intermediate cert due to newline parsing. - Remediation: add CI check to validate concatenated PEM lengths and rotate artifact propagation timeout to 60s. - Follow-up: run a full fleet audit for certificate bundle consistency.

Priya S: I'll create the incident ticket and assign follow-ups: INC-2026-378. Will tag infra, rotator, and release teams.

oncall-rotation: Handoff to next oncall in 15m. Status: mitigated, monitoring.

Eli M: Thanks team. I'll keep watch for 30m, then close thread. :white_check_mark:
